correctness.rationale: Uniform independent continuous chords give uniform matchings on ordered endpoints. Exact conditional kernels q_C=2l(1-l), q_N=l^2+2a(1-b) yield projection means 1/3, variance 1/45 each and cross projection covariance 0 by exact integration. Same-pair exclusivity gives -1/9, and all distinct shared-chord mixed covariances vanish; exact finite Cov(C,N)=-n(n-1)/18 and Var=n(n-1)(n+3)/45 follow. Bounded degenerate U-statistic remainders have variance O(n^2); multivariate iid CLT for first projection yields independent centered normals of variance 1/45. The independent recursive matching enumerator checks 146599 instances and 84 exact identities (n<=7); a separate 90-word triple-interleaving check and exact symbolic integration pass. No finite check is treated as proof of convergence.

value.rationale: Crossing and nesting counts are naturally paired geometric statistics on random chord diagrams. At every finite size they have a strictly negative covariance, yet their order-n^(3/2) fluctuations are asymptotically independent. The zero mixed first-order chord projection and the universal diagonal limiting covariance matrix identify a mathematically meaningful structural separation, permitting simultaneous asymptotic calibration of these counts. This is not merely an enumeration of cells in the prior finite generating polynomial. It does not establish a convergence rate or generalize to nonuniform matchings.
